name: IvyPay
one_liner: HIPAA-compliant payment processing built specifically for therapists with 2.75% flat rate and no monthly fees.
short_description: IvyPay is a HIPAA-compliant payment processor designed specifically for therapists and mental health providers, offering simple flat-rate pricing with no monthly fees.
long_description: IvyPay is a payment processing platform built exclusively for therapists and mental health professionals. Unlike generic payment processors, IvyPay is fully HIPAA-compliant and provides a BAA, making it safe to collect payments that may include session details or client names. The platform charges a simple 2.75% flat rate per transaction with no monthly fees, setup fees, or hidden costs. IvyPay integrates with popular EHR systems like SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, and Jane, and connects with bookkeeping services like Heard. Features include recurring billing, card-on-file storage, text-to-pay invoicing, and automatic payment reminders. The mobile app allows clinicians to accept payments anywhere. IvyPay was designed by therapists who understood the unique compliance and workflow needs of mental health practices.
best_for: Solo therapists wanting simple payment processing
Practices wanting to avoid monthly fees
Therapists who want to text invoices to clients
